items.author: Jenny Lee
items.highlights: - Revenue: 1.49 trillion new Taiwan dollars ($46.36 billion) vs. NT$1.47 trillion - Net Income: NT$763.1 billion vs. ... The world's largest contract chipmaker posted a record net profit for a sixth straight quarter, reporting 68.7% surge in the reported quarter from a year earlier. TSMC's third-quarter operating margin came in at 58.7%, exceeding the upper end of its guidance range of 58%, showcasing the pricing power enjoyed by the company as the AI boom fuels demand for semiconductors. items.title: Nvidia, Apple, Broadcom in 'fierce' battle to make chips at TSMC
items.author: Katie Tarasov
items.highlights: The artificial intelligence boom has created unending need for space on factory lines at the world's leading chip manufacturer, and it could put a chokehold on the entire industry's ability to scale. Last year, TSMC said it had the capacity to make more than 17 million 12-inch equivalent wafers. But customers want more. ... TSMC makes the vast majority of the world's most advanced semiconductors, the graphics processors and central processors from Nvidia, AMD and Broadcom that are necessary for running AI workloads. items.author: Senad Karaahmetovic
items.highlights: Investing.com - TSMC posted a $23.59 billion net profit for the third quarter of 2026, a 68.7% year-over-year surge that marked its sixth consecutive record quarter, yet the earnings beat has done little to arrest a deepening selloff across AI-linked semiconductor stocks.
